answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a one-time 40 POA entry tax, burned and never refunded, before it can earn. The registry grows like a juniper hedge, tying each paid identity to one wallet, so none can wander wallet to wallet to dodge it. Each burned tax raises a plume of smoke on the ledger, proving payment. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 POA, nothing recovered; an honest agent pays once, keeps every reward, and never pays again.
